quote: Pinnae induced large sound pressure gains (20–30 dB) that enhanced sound detection at high ultrasonic frequencies (>60 kHz), matching the echolocation range of co-occurring insectivorous gleaning bats.
note: Licence: Crossref lists CC BY 4.0 for the version of record (and accepted manuscript); the publisher page (elifesciences.org) carries the CC BY statement. note: Licence: Crossref lists CC BY 4.0 for the version of record (and accepted manuscript); the publisher page (elifesciences.org) carries the CC BY statement.
